meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 它会完整读取项目中的每个源代码文件,不论多少,大文件分页读完,从而整体了解代码库。
howto.when: 当开始新项目或不熟悉项目,或用户要求“学习代码库”(如说“learn the codebase”等)时触发。

say.note: 它将逐个读取所有源文件。

say.text: 把这个项目的所有源码读一遍。
我对项目不熟,先帮我读一遍代码。

howto.what_en: It reads every source file in full, no matter how many, paging through large files, to understand the whole codebase.
howto.when_en: When starting a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user says “learn the codebase” or “read the codebase” etc.

say_en.note: It will read all source files.

say_en.text: Read all the source files in this project.
I'm unfamiliar with this project. Read the code first.
